dataList.name: Wandering Ordeal
dataList.desc:
Saat memasuki pertempuran, peroleh 1~3 [RunHallway]
Awal Giliran: Pada 0 [RunHallway], gunakan 'Herd Migration'
(Jika unit ini kena Stagger, pulih dari Stagger ketika efek ini triggers)

Jika 'BunBun' is on the battlefield, this passive tidak mengaktifkan
dataList.flavor: 'Ordeals are quite distinct dari Abnormalities—they are vivid representations of intense traumas, dredged up at acak dari humanity's dreams that course through the farthest depths of this company.'

dataList.name: Tailored for the Palate
dataList.desc: On Attack Hit terhadap a target dengan a damage type target is "Lemah" atau "Fatal" (Resistance > 1) to, beri 1 [Binding] giliran berikutnya (sekali per Skill)
dataList.flavor: "How could such a flavorful beverage end up being called BongBong?"

dataList.name: The Secret of Taste
dataList.desc: Beri 1 [PumpkinJelly] pada target that killed unit ini

dataList.name: Wandering Ordeal
dataList.desc:
Awal Pertempuran: Peroleh 3 [RunHallway]
Awal Giliran: Pada 0 [RunHallway], gunakan 'Herd Migration'
(Jika unit ini kena Stagger, pulih dari Stagger ketika efek ini triggers)

Jika tidak ada BongBongs left on the battlefield kecuali for "BongBongs spawned sebanyak unit ini", efek Skill of 'Herd Migration' do not aktifkan, dan unit ini peroleh 3 [RunHallway] giliran berikutnya
dataList.flavor: "These Ordeal things keep popping out dari that murky-white smoke... just what is that smoke supposed to be, Captain?!"

dataList.name: Lasting Ordeal
dataList.desc:
Once 4 giliran pass setelah unit ini Retreats, unit ini dan semua available "BongBongs spawned sebanyak unit ini" Return to the battlefield. Lalu, peroleh 3 [RunHallway]

Jika semua available combat participant spots are filled, Mundur a acak BongBong unit dan Return to the battlefield.

dataList.name: Fragile Orange Bubble
dataList.desc: Ketika diserang sebanyak Serangan Tanpa Lawan, terima +100% damage Ketika clash terhadap Skill that spend Ammo, Clash Power -3 dan ubah semua Coin on its Skill Attack to Regular Coin.
dataList.flavor: "I know those carbonated bubbles are tasty, but be careful around them, okay? They're unprocessed dan highly acidic. Sure, a few spatters of little BongBongs' pop bubbles might not be so dangerous, but getting doused in the undiluted fluid of those massive BunBuns'll melt you guys menjadi a puddle."

dataList.name: Food Production
dataList.desc:
Saat Membunuh, summon 1 BongBong
Akhir Giliran: Pada 0 [RunHallway] Stack, summon as many BongBongs as possible giliran berikutnya
dataList.flavor: "Apparently, they've got this special, top-secret carbonation formula. Like an in-house recipe."
